verdict.rationale: Appwrite Storage documents APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, and says assets are served through the Appwrite CDN with bucket-level compression and encryption. Image preview transforms and metadata stripping on uploads add to the core upload-and-serve story. However, no storage-specific evidence covers file or bucket access rules or permissions; missing for 10: documented per-file/bucket access rules, independent or hands-on corroboration of CDN delivery.
